or ग्रन्थ् 1 Ā. (also 9, 10 P. [[L. D. B.]]) (ग्रथते, ग्रन्थते) 
__1 To be crooked. 
__2 To be wicked. 
__3 To bend.

__1 Coagulation, thickening, becoming obstructed or clogged with knotty lumps. 
__2 Stringing together. 
__3 Composing, writing; (ना also in these senses).
[ग्रन्थ् बा° नङ्] A cluster, bunch, tuft.

p. p. [ग्रन्थ् संदर्भे क्त नलोपः] 
__1 Strung or tied together. 
__2 Composed; कालिदासग्रथितवस्तुना नाटकेन [[Ś. 1]]; वर्णैः कतिपयैरेव ग्रथितस्य स्वरैरिव [[Śi. 2. 72.]] 
__3 Arranged, classed. 
__4 Thickened, coagulated. 
__5 Knotty. 
__6 Hardened. 
__7 Hurt, injured. 
__8 Seized, taken possession of. 
__9 Overcome. 
-तम् A tumor with hard knots.

€1, 9 P., 10 U., 1 Ā. (ग्रन्थति, ग्रथ्नाति, ग्रन्थयतिते, also ग्रथति, ग्रथते) 
__1 To fasten, tie or string together; ग्रन्थित्वेव स्थितं रुचः [[

]]; स्रजो ग्रथयते &c. 
__2 To arrange, class together, connect in a regular series. 
__3 To wind round. 
__4 To write, compose; ग्रथ्नामि काव्यशशिनं विततार्थरश्मिम् [[K.

.]] 
__5 To form, make, produce; ग्रथ्नन्ति बाष्पविन्दुनिकरं पक्ष्मपङ्क्तयः [[

[ग्रन्थ् संदर्भे भाबे घञ्] 
__1 Binding, stringing together (fig. also). 
__2 A work, treatise, composition, literary production, book; ग्रन्थारम्भे, ग्रन्थकृत्, ग्रन्थसमाप्ति &c. 
__3 Wealth, property. 
__4 A verse consisting of 32 syllables, written in the Anuṣṭubh metre. 
-Comp. 
-कर्तृ, m. 
-कारः -कृत् m. a writer, an author; ग्रन्थारम्भे समुचितेष्टदेवतां ग्रन्थकृत्परामृशति [[K.

.]] 
-कुटी, -कूटी 
__1 a library. [Page0677-2] 
__2 a studio. 
-विस्तरः, विस्तारः voluminousness, diffuse style; [[Bṛ.

.]] 
-संधिः a section or chapter of a work; (for the several names by which sections, or chapters of works in Sanskṛt, are called, see under अध्याय).

ग्रन्थनम्,
 
-ना [ग्रन्थ भावे ल्युट्] 
__1 Stringing or tying together. 
__2 Composing, writing.
__1 A knot, bunch, protuberance in general; स्तनौ मांसग्रन्थी कनककलशावित्युपमितौ [[

]]; so मेदोग्रन्थि. 
__2 A tie or knot of a cord, garment &c; इदमुपहितसूक्ष्मग्रन्थिना स्कन्धदेशे [[Ś. 1. 19]]; [[

.]] 
__3 A knot tied in the end of a garment for keeping money; hence, purse, money, property; कुसीदाद् दारिद्र्यं परकरगतग्नन्थिशमनात् [[

.]] 
__4 The joint or knot of a reed, cane &c. [[

.]] 
__5 A joint of the body. 
__6 Crookedness, distortion, falsehood, perversion of truth. 
__7 Swelling and hardening of the vessels of the body. 
__8 A difficult portion; ग्रन्थग्रन्थिं तदा चक्रे मुनिर्गूढं कुतूहलात् [[

.]] 
__9 A bell, gong; गृहीत्वा ग्रन्थिमुसलं मूढो भिक्षुरवादयत् [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-छेदकः, -भेदः, -मोचकः a cut-purse, a pick pocket; अङ्गुलीग्रन्थिभेदस्य छेदयेत् प्रथमे ग्रहे [[

.]] 
__2 a kind of perfume. 
-बन्धनम् 
__1 tying together the garments of the bride and the bridegroom at the marriage ceremony. 
__2 tying a knot. 
__3 a ligament. 
-मूलम् garlic. 
-वज्रकः a kind of steel. 
-हरः a minister.
€1An astrologer, a fortune-teller; ग्रन्थिकस्तु करीरे स्याद्दैवज्ञे गुग्गुलुद्रुमे’

.]] 
__2 The name assumed by Nakula when at the palace of Virāṭa. 
__3 A kind of disease of the outer ear. 
__4 A Bamboo-shoot; [[L. D. B.]] कम् 
__1 The plant Piper longum (Mar. गांठी पिंपळमूळ). 
__2 The gum-resin (गुग्गुलु).

m. 
__1 One who reads books, bookish; अज्ञेभ्यो ग्रन्थिनः श्रेष्ठा ग्रन्थिभ्यो धारिणो वराः [[
a. Knotty, tied by a knot; कृष्णत्वचं ग्रन्थिमतीं दधानम् [[

a. [ग्रन्थिर्विद्यतेऽस्य सिध्मा°लच्] Knotted, knotty. 
-लम् 
__1 The root of long pepper. 
__2 Undried ginger.

Ā. [ग्रसते, ग्रस्त] 
__1 To swallow, devour, eat up, consume; स इमां पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां संक्षिप्य ग्रसते पुनः [[Mb.]]; [[

.]] 
__2 To seize. 
__3 To eclipse; द्वावेव ग्रसते दिनेश्वरनिशाप्राणेश्वरौ भासुरौ [[
P., 10 U. (ग्रसति, ग्रासयति-ते) To eat, devour.

[ग्रस् भावे ल्युट्] 
__1 Swallowing, eating. 
__2 Seizing. 
__3 A partial eclipse of the sun or moon; [[Bṛ.

]], 46. 
__4 A mouth, jaw; प्राशित्रमास्ये ग्रसने ग्रहास्तु ते [[
a. Accustomed to swallow; भूतभर्तृ च यज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च [[

p. p. [ग्रस् कर्मणि क्त] 
__1 Eaten, devoured. 
__2 Seized, stricken, affected, possessed; ग्रह°, विपद्°, जरा° [[

.]] 
-स्तम् A word or sentence half-uttered or slurred over. 
-Comp. 
-अस्तम् the setting of the sun or moon while eclipsed. 
-उदयः rising of the sun or moon while eclipsed.
f. The act of swallowing or devouring.

[ग्रस् कर्मणि घञ्] 
__1 A mouthful, a quantity of anything equal to a mouthful; [[

.]] 
__2 Food, nourishment; ग्रासाच्छादनमात्रं तु दद्यादिति निदर्शनम् [[

.]] 
__3 The part of the sun or the moon eclipsed. 
__4 The morsel bitten. 
__5 The act of swallowing. 
__6 Slurring, indistinct pronunciation; fault in a pronunciation of the gutturals. 
__7 (In geom.) A piece cut out by the intersection of two circles 8 An eclipse. 
-Comp. 
-आच्छादनम् food and clothing; i. e. bare subsistence; see ग्रास (2); [[

.]] 
-प्रमाणम् the size of a morsel. 
-शल्यम् any extraneous substance lodged in the throat. 
-ग्रासीकृ To swallow; ग्रासीकर्तुं प्रवृत्तोऽभूदुत्थायाजगरो महान् [[

€9U. (In Vedic literature ग्रभ्; गृह्णाति, जग्राह, अग्रहीत्, ग्रहीतुम्, गृहीत caus. ग्राहयति; desid. जिघृक्षति) 
__1 To seize, take, take or catch hold of, lay hold of, catch, grasp; तयोर्जग्रहतुः पादान् राजा राज्ञी च मागधी [[
]]; आलाने गृह्यते हस्ती वाजी वल्गासु गृह्यते [[

.]] पाणिं गृहीत्वा, चरणं गृहीत्वा &c. 
__2 To receive, take, accept, exact; प्रजानामेव भूत्यर्थं स ताभ्यो बलिमग्रहीत् [[

]]; 9. 162. 
__3 To apprehend, capture, take prisoner. बन्दिग्राहं गृहीत्वा [[

.]] 
__4 To arrest, stop, catch; अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते [[

.]] 
__6 To win over, persuade, induce to one's side; लुब्धमर्थेन गृह्णीयात् [[

]], 184. 
__7 (Hence) To please, gratify, satisfy, propitiate; ग्रहीतुमार्यान् परिचर्यया मुहुर्महानुभावा हि नितान्तमर्थिनः [[Śi. 1. 17]], 33. 
__8 To affect; seize or possess (as a demon, spirit &c.); as in पिशाचगृहीत, वेतालगृहीत. 
__9 To assume, take; द्युतिमग्रहीद् ग्रहगणः [[Śi. 9. 23]]; [[

.]] 
__10 To learn, know, recognize, understand; युवतीजनैर्जग्रहे मुनिप्रभावः [[

.]] 
__11 To regard, consider, [Page0678-2] believe, take for; मयापि मृत्पिण्डबुद्धिना तथैव गृहीतम् [[Ś. 6]]; परिहासविजल्पितं सखे परमार्थेन न गृह्यतां वचः [[Ś. 2. 19]]; एवं जनो गृह्णाति [[

.]] 
__12 To catch or perceive (as by an organ of sense); ज्यानिनादमथ गृह्णती तयोः [[

.]] 
__13 To master, grasp, comprehend; न्यस्ताक्षरामक्षरभूमिकायां कार्त्स्न्येन गृह्णाति लिपिं न यावत् [[

.]] 
__14 To guess, conjecture, infer; नेत्रवक्त्रविकारैश्च गृह्यतेऽन्तर्गतं मनः [[

.]] 
__15 To utter, mention (as a name); यदि मयान्यस्य नामापि न गृहितम् [[
]]; न तु नामापि गृह्णीयात् पत्यौ प्रेते परस्य तु [[

.]] 
__16 To buy, purchase; कियता मूल्येनैतत्पुस्तकं गृहीतम् [[

.]] 
__17 To deprive (one) of, take away from, rob or seize away; यथा रणे प्राणान् बहूनामग्रहीद् द्विषाम् [[

]]; 15. 63. 
__18 To wear, put on (as clothes &c.); वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि [[

.]] 
__19 To conceive. 
__20 To observe (as a fast). 
__21 To eclipse. 
__22 To undertake, undergo, begin. 
__23 To take up, draw (water.); अपस्फुरं गृभायत सोममिन्द्राय पातवे [[

.]] 
__24 To stop, intercept. 
__25 To withdraw, draw back; यथार्णनाभिः सृजते गृह्णते [[

.]] 
__26 To include. 
__27 To receive hospitably (as a guest). [The senses of this root may be variously modified according to the noun with which it is joined]. -Caus. 
__1 To cause to take, catch, seize or accept. 
__2 To give away in marriage; अयाचितारं न हि देवदेवमद्रिः सुतां ग्राहयितुं शशाक [[

.]] 
__3 To teach, make one acquainted with. 
__4 To make one take, deliver over to. 
__5 To become familiar with; -With अनुसम् to salute humbly. 
-अप to take away, tear off. 
-अभि to seize forcibly. --
P., 10 U. (ग्रहति, ग्राहयति-ते) To take, receive, &c.

[ग्रह्-अच्] 
__1 Seizing, grasping, laying hold of, seizure, रुरुधुः कचग्रहैः [[

.]] 
__2 A grip, grasp, hold; विक्रम्य कौशिकं खङ्गं मोक्षयित्वा ग्रहं रिपोः [[

.]] 
__3 Taking, receiving, accepting; receipt. 
__4 Stealing, robbing; अङ्गुलीग्रन्थिभेदस्य छेदयेत्प्रथमे ग्रहे [[

]]; so गोग्रहः. 
__5 Booty, spoil. 
__6 Eclipse; see ग्रहण. 
__7 A planet, (sometimes more particularly ‘Rāhu’; वध्यमाने ग्रहेणाथ आदित्ये मन्युराविशत् [[
.]]) (the planets are nine:--सूर्यश्चन्द्रो मङ्गलश्च बुधश्चापि बृहस्पतिः । शुक्रः शनैश्चरो राहुः केतुश्चेति ग्रहा नव ॥); नक्षत्रताराग्रहसंकुलापि (रात्रिः) [[
]]; 3. 13; 12. 28; गुरुणा स्तनभारेण मुखचन्द्रेण भास्वता । शनैश्चराभ्यां पादाभ्यां रेजे ग्रहमयीव सा ॥ [[

.]] 
__8 Mentioning; utterance, repeating (as of a name) नामजातिग्रहं त्वेषामभिद्रोहेण कुर्वतः [[

.]] 
__9 A shark, crocodile. 
__10 An imp in general. 
__11 A particular class of evil demons supposed to seize upon children and produce convulsions &c. cf. [[Mb.]] Crit. ed. 3. 219. 26; कृष्णग्रहगृहीतात्मा न वेद जगदीदृशम् [[

-22.]] 
__13 An organ or instrument of apprehension; [[Bṛ.

.]] 
__14 Tenacity, perseverance, persistence; नृणां स्वत्वग्रहो यतः [[

.]] 
__15 Purpose, design. 
__16 Favour, patronage. 
__17 The place of a planet in the fixed zodiac. 
__18 The number ‘nine’. 
__19 Any state of mind which proceeds from magical influences. 
__20 A house. 
__21 A spoonful, ladleful; ग्रहान्त्सोमस्य मिमते द्वादश [[

.]] 
__22 A ladle or vessel; चमसानां ग्रहाणां च शुद्धिः प्रक्षालनेन तु [[

.]] 
__23 The middle of a bow. 
__24 A movable point in the heavens. 
__25 Keeping back, obstructing. 
__26 Taking away, depriving; प्राण° [[

.]] 
__27 Preparation for war; ग्रहोऽवग्रहनिर्बन्धग्रहणेषु रणोद्यमे । सूर्यादौ पूतनादौ च सैंहिकेयेऽपि तत् त्रिषु । [[Nm.]] 
__28 A guest (अतिथि); यथा सिद्धस्य चान्नस्य ग्रहायाग्रं प्रदीयते [[

.]] 
-अधीन a. subject to planetary influence. 
-अवमर्दनः an epithet of Rāhu. 
(-नम्) friction of the planets. 
-अधीशः the sun. 
-आधारः, -आश्रयः polar star (as the fixed centre of the planets). 
-आमयः 
__1 epilepsy. 
__2 demoniacal possession. 
-आलुञ्चनम् pouncing on one's prey, tearing it to pieces; श्येनो ग्रहालुञ्चने [[

.]] 
-आवर्तः horoscope. 
-ईशः the sun. 
-एकत्वन्यायः the rule according to which the gender and number of उद्देशपद is not necessarily combined along with the action laid down in the विधेयपद. This is discussed by जैमिनि and शबर at [[MS.

-15]] (opp. of अरुणान्याय or पश्वेकत्वन्याय). 
-कल्लोलः an epithet of Rāhu. 
-कुण्डलिका the mutual relation of planets and prophecy derived from it. 
-गणितम् the astronomical part of a ज्योतिःशास्त्र. 
-गतिः the motion of the planets. 
-ग्रामणी the sun. 
-चिन्तकः an astrologer. 
-दशा the aspect of a planet, the time during which it continues to exercise its influence. 
-देवता the deity that presides over a planet. 
-नायकः [Page0679-2] 
__1 the sun. 
__2 an epithet of Saturn. 
-निग्रहौ (du.) reward and punishment. 
-नेमिः 
__1 the moon. 
__2 the section of the moon's course between the asterisms मूल and मृगशीर्ष. 
-पतिः 
__1 the sun. 
__2 the moon; तस्य विस्तीर्यते राज्यं ज्योत्स्ना ग्रहपतेरिव [[

.]] 
-पीडनम्, -पीडा 
__1 oppression caused by a planet. 
__2 an eclipse; शशिदिवाकरयोर्ग्रहपीडनम् [[

.]] 
-पुषः the sun. 
-भक्तिः f. division of countries &c. with respect to the presiding planets. 
-भोजनः 
__1 oblation offered to the planets. 
__2 a horse. 
-मण्डलम्, -ली the circle of the planets. 
-यज्ञः, -योगः worship or sacrifice planets. 
-युद्ध opposition of planets. 
-राजः 
__1 the sun. 
__2 the moon. 
__3 Jupiter. 
-लाघवम् N. of an astronomical work of the 16th century. 
-वर्षः the planetary year. 
-विप्रः an astrologer. 
-शान्तिः f. propitiation of planets by sacrifices &c. 
-शृङ्गाटकम् triangular position of the planets with reference to one another. 
-सङ्गमः conjunction of planets. 
-स्वरः the 1st note of a musical piece.

[ग्रह् भावे ल्युट्] 
__1 Seizing, catching, seizure; श्वा मृगग्रहणेऽशुचिः [[

.]] 
__3 Mentioning, uttering; नामग्रहणम्. 
__4 Wearing putting on; सोत्तरच्छदमध्यास्त नेपथ्यग्रहणाय सः [[

.]] 
__6 Understanding, comprehension, knowledge; यस्य नु ग्रहणं किंचित्कर्मणोऽन्यन्न दृश्यते [[

.]] 
__7 Learning, acquiring, grasping mentally, mastering; लिपेर्यथावद्ग्रहणेन वाङ्मयं नदीमुखेनेव समुद्रमाविशत् [[

.]] 
__8 Taking up of sound, echo; अद्रिग्रहणगुरुभिर्गर्जितैर्नर्तयेथाः [[

.]] 
__9 The hand. 
__10 An organ of sense. 
__11 A prisoner, captive. 
__12 Taking by the hand, marrying; तद्दारग्रहणे यत्नं सन्तत्यां च मनः कुरु [[

.]] 
__13 Taking captive, imprisonment; न दोषो ग्रहणे तस्याः [[

.]] 
__14 Gaining, obtaining, purchasing. 
__15 Choosing. 
__16 Taking or drawing up. 
__17 Attraction. 
__18 Containing, enclosing. 
__19 Undertaking, undergoing. 
__20 Service; अजस्य जन्मोत्पथनाशनाय कर्माण्यकर्तुर्ग्रहणाय पुंसाम् [[

.]] 
__21 Mentioning with praise, respecting; प्रमाणं सर्बभूतेषु गत्वा च ग्रहणं महत् [[

.]] 
__22 Acceptation, meaning. 
__23 Assent, agreement. 
__24 Inviting, calling, addressing; name; अलसग्रहणं प्राप्तो दुर्मेधावी तथोच्यते [[

ग्रहणिः,
 
-णी f. 
__1 An imaginary organ supposed to lie between the stomach and the intestines. 
__2 The small intestines or that part of the alimentary canal where the bile assists digestion and from which vital warmth is diffused. 
__3 Diarrhoea, dysentery. [Page0680-1] 
-Comp. 
-कपाटः a kind of mixture (for curing diarrhoea &c.). 
-हरम् cloves.

a. 
__1 Taking, accepting. 
__2 Unyielding, relentless, obstinate; न निशाखिलयापि वापिका प्रससाद ग्रहिलेव मानिनी [[

a. 
__1 To be taken, seized or received, acceptable. 
__2 To be taken up or drawn (as a fluid). 
__3 To be apprehended or perceived, to be learnt or acquired.

a. (त्री f.) [ग्रह्-तृच् इटो दीर्घः] 
__1 A taker, an accepter; as in गुणग्रहीतृ q. v. 
__2 Perceiver, observant; [[

.]] 
__3 Debtor; ग्रहीता यदि वै नष्टः कुटुम्बार्थे कृतो व्ययः [[

a. (ही f.) [ग्रह् भावे घञ्] Seizing, clutching; taking, holding, receiving &c. 
-हः 
__1 Seizing, grasping; हस्तग्राहं तु तं मत्बा [[

.]] 
__3 A prisoner. 
__4 Accepting. 
__5 Understanding, knowledge. 
__6 Persistence, importunity; तव मातुरसद्ग्राहं विद्म पूर्वं यथा श्रुतम् [[

.]] 
__7 Determination, resolve; मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः [[

.]] 
__8 A disease. 
__9 Any large fish or marine animal; जग्राहाजगरो ग्राहो भुजयोरुभयोर्बलात् [[
